card.title: Help Me Make This Normal
card.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pass the talking cupboard a napkin. Let's make dinner normal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put it beside the handle, like a considerate host.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please. Ask which shelf it eats from. We can't keep making our guest explain everything.

mechanism: A recruits B into ordinary hospitality toward a talking cupboard so its strangeness becomes an etiquette problem.
confusable: Unlike merely accepting a fantasy premise, A must actively get B to perform the normalizing behavior.
comparison: A cupboard needs adapted table manners; the invisible guest needs introductions and a second chair.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
